title: HITECH Records Request (example — Apache Health Center)
naming: MED – Apache Health Center - HITECH Request mm.dd.yyyy (VA's name)
note: Hand-authored, not GENERATED: the one HITECH Request letter the trainers sent (Apache Health Center) has no yellow highlighting to key off of, unlike the Lien BV and MedLOR templates. Only the date and the Date of Service line are marked as fields here by hand; everything else, including both Unsworn Declarations the provider's own staff complete and sign, is the firm's fixed wording, exactly as sent, and is kept as a reference example rather than switched per assigned provider.

runs.x:
Apache Health Center
3555 S Fort Apache Road Ste 151
Las Vegas, NV 89147-3444
I am your patient. I am requesting:
a full and complete copy of my medical records for the dates of service reference above (including MRIs or CT scans or any other imaging, and any other outside medical records); and
I specifically request that you certify the records and provide them in PDF format on CD or DVD.

Van Law Firm
1290 S. Jones Blvd.
Las Vegas, NV 89146
My attorney will pay the HITECH federally limited charges of $6.50 for these records. My Attorney will also pay a certification fee not to exceed $10.00 and requests am itemization of all charges.
UNSWORN DECLARATION OF CUSTODIAN OF RECORDS
(completed and signed by the provider's own records custodian — not by you)
I,______________________, being first duly sworn, deposes and says:
1. That I am the _______________________ for ____________________________and in that capacity, I act as the Custodian
2. That ____________________________ is licensed or registered to do business as a ____________________________

3. That on the ____ day of the month of ________________, of the year________, I received a request calling for the production of all records, bills, and/or radiology films in our facility’s possession and control pertaining to: John Test Doe; March 28, 1997; 111-222-1234
4. That myself and/or another person acting under my supervision and control made a complete search of all available records.
5. That our facility’s Records Department maintains records for ______ years.

6. That our facility’s Records Department located the records and things, the copies of which have been produced with this certificate. I have examined the original of these records and things and have made or caused to be made a true and exact copy of them and that the reproduction of them attached hereto is true and complete.

7. That the original of these records was made at or near the time of the act, event, condition, opinion, or diagnosis recited therein by or from information transmitted by a person with knowledge, in the course of a regularly conducted activity of the affiant and/or ____________________________.

☐	 If executed outside of the State of Nevada: “I declare under penalty of perjury under the law of the State of Nevada that the foregoing is true and correct.”
